environment.model_endpoint_disclosure: Maintainer directive (2026-11-06): no OpenRouter budget. The free tier's 50 free-model requests/day provably cannot carry the journey (run 42235226375: MJ0-MJ3 green, every MJ4+ model turn 429 free-models-per-day, x-ratelimit-limit 50 remaining 0). The journey therefore runs against a deterministic scripted model endpoint — the same class of test infrastructure as the repository's upstream E2E replay fixtures. Everything the APP does is real (custom-provider settings surface, session turns, SSE streaming parse, tool round-trips, the dynamic-workflows skill gate, the CreateWorkflow approval gate, subagent scheduling, the Dynamic Workflow compiler/runtime, dwf_* journal, resume, persistence across restart). Only the model intelligence behind the endpoint is scripted. No claim of real-LLM authorship is made; the full model request transcript is preserved in the run artifact (m1-local-model-transcript.jsonl).
